title: Context is the text available now
summary: The context is the information supplied for the current response. A context window limits how many tokens a model can handle in a request and its response.
introduction: The context is the information supplied for the current response. A context window limits how many tokens a model can handle in a request and its response. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain context is the text available now
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: The context is the information supplied for the current response. A context window limits how many tokens a model can handle in a request and its response.

blocks.code:
Available context: The club meets on Friday.
Question: Which day is the meeting?
Supported answer: Friday
Missing detail: the meeting time
blocks.title: Context is the text available now

blocks.text: The model can use the supplied day. It should not claim a meeting time from this context. Long conversations may need summaries or selected passages.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a short context sentence that also provides the time.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A model does not automatically see every file on a computer or every earlier conversation.
